CORRECTED 2026-08-22. This was first labelled NOT_IN_UNIVERSE on the stated ground that its price coincided with an OpenAI anchor in only one period. That was simply wrong, and reading the rows settles it the other way: the title is 'OpenAir.com, Series C', the price is 687.6869 on both 2026-03-31 and 2026-04-30, and 687.6869 is the OpenAI Series C consensus -- eight holdings across six registrants whose identity is not in dispute report it to the same four decimals on the first of those dates. (Corrected again 2026-08-23: those eight were described here as LEI-confirmed, which was wrong. One carries OpenAI's registered issuer identifier; the other seven name OpenAI outright. Both are unimpeachable evidence classes, but they are not the same one.) The five holdings are BlackRock's (three) and New York Life's (two). Every issuer priced at 687.69 in those two periods is an OpenAI spelling. 'OpenAir.com' is a security-master collision with a defunct dot-com of that name; the position is OpenAI Group PBC.
